what: A7 revision gate on the authoritative A7 controller board (R4, #19): fresh ERC, netlist, schematic parity, DRC (0 violations, 0 unconnected), zone refill, behavioral interface and authorized-delta checks, controls on the candidate's own copper, and regeneration preservation.

ignored_checks.description: Track endpoint not centered on via
Footprint doesn't match symbol's footprint filters
Footprint component type doesn't match footprint pads

drc.ignored_checks_note: KiCad 10.0.8 default ignore set. A7-specific residuals or dispositions are added only with fresh justification; nothing is inherited from A6 (e.g. its H1/J3 courtyard residual).

a5_led_leaf.role: immutable A5 routed LED leaf (interface partner of the controller; PET leaf is R3), freshly checked in place

a5_power_adapter.role: immutable A5 routed power adapter (interface partner), freshly checked in place

regeneration.note: Normal regeneration of the derived A7 schematic, footprints and seed placement must leave the protected board byte-identical; the placement export is compared (--check) against fresh native facts of the board.

design_rule_delta.what: Authorized A7 changes to the A5 controller design rules. Every other A5 rule (clearance 0.15, edge 0.2, hole clearance 0.2, track 0.15, via annular 0.15) is unchanged. The project file is derived (scripts/a7_electronics.py A7_STYLE rule_delta) and a test proves it equals the A5 rules plus exactly this delta.
design_rule_delta.reason: MCU (QFN28, 0.5 mm pitch) and U5 (VSSOP-8) fan-out on the 16.2 mm controller: with 0.6/0.3 vias the routed candidate could not be completed (rip-up router left 1-7 nets blocked around U1/U5, PR #30). Approved by the coordinator 2026-11-08 under conditions: fabricator capability evidence, recorded delta, no trace/clearance relaxation, no layer change.

parity_disposition_note: A5 leaf/adapter boards name nets without the schematic's '/' sheet prefix, leave the no-connect D4.1 unnamed, omit the MPN field and (adapter) carry hole H1 without a symbol. Naming/metadata classes only; the independent pad-by-pad parity still runs. Carried from PR #14 for the A5 leaf and adapter only. The A7 controller has no dispositions: its board takes net names and fields from the A7 schematic netlist, so any parity issue fails.

a5_controller.role: immutable A5 controller (unrouted placement draft): must fail in exactly its recorded way

control_fill_shift.purpose: one committed fill moved 0.05 mm with unchanged area and vertex count; the canonical polygon fingerprint must still differ from a fresh refill
